D1.description: Create the complete public TLS client transport API; this is the only D1 operation touching tls_header.

D2.description: Create the final TLS transport implementation; this is the only operation that ever touches tls_source.

idempotentContains: static int wc_tls_configure_trust(SSL_CTX* context, int allow_environment_override)

postApplyAssertions.name: D2_HANDSHAKE_ERROR_VERIFY_RESULT_ONCE
postApplyAssertions.pattern: if \(error != SSL_ERROR_WANT_READ && error != SSL_ERROR_WANT_WRITE\) \{\n            if \(SSL_get_verify_result\(context->ssl\) != X509_V_OK\)

postApplyAssertions.name: D2_TLS_SOURCE_SINGLE_CREATE
postApplyAssertions.pattern: // tls\.c - optional OpenSSL client transport for HTTPS proxy endpoints

D3.description: Parse HTTPS proxy endpoints, gate routing on WHOIS_TLS, and cover default port and build behavior.

opts_source: Error: HTTPS proxy requires a WHOIS_TLS=1 build

operations.replacement:
#ifdef WHOIS_TLS
    out->routing_enabled = out->scheme == WC_PROXY_SCHEME_HTTPS ||
        out->scheme == WC_PROXY_SCHEME_HTTP ||
#else
    out->routing_enabled = out->scheme == WC_PROXY_SCHEME_HTTP ||
#endif
        out->scheme == WC_PROXY_SCHEME_SOCKS5 ||

idempotentContains: fprintf(stderr, "Error: HTTPS proxy requires a WHOIS_TLS=1 build\n");

postApplyAssertions.name: D3_HTTPS_FINAL_ERROR_ONCE
postApplyAssertions.pattern: Error: HTTPS proxy requires a WHOIS_TLS=1 build

D4.description: Wrap HTTPS proxy endpoint TCP connections in TLS before CONNECT and preserve A transport ownership.

idempotentContains: wc_tls_result_t wc_tls_wrap_client(int fd, const char* peer_name, uint64_t deadline_ms, wc_transport_t** out_transport);

operations.pattern: case WC_PROXY_RESULT_TCP_FAILURE: return \"proxy-tcp-failure\";\n        case WC_PROXY_RESULT_TIMEOUT: return \"proxy-timeout\";

idempotentContains: [PROXY] scheme=https phase=tls port=%u result=proxy-tls-failure tls=%s status=0

postApplyAssertions.name: D4_FINAL_OWNER_MOVE_ONCE
postApplyAssertions.pattern: wc_net_info_move\(out, &endpoint\);\n    if \(proxy_result\) \*proxy_result = result;\n    return result == WC_PROXY_RESULT_SUCCEEDED
